description: Surface Routes and Schedules for BusTime is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The TTC may provide additional updates as required to address service impacts and/or changes. Data contains scheduling information (route definitions, stop patterns, stop locations, schedules and alerts) for surface (buses and streetcars) only. The data is published as a GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) file format. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
